tools.name: get_order_status
tools.title: Get order status
tools.description: Returns the status of one AIDevMe order by its number (for example SO-10023): order lines, carrier, tracking number and expected delivery date.

orderId.description: Order number in the format SO-<digits>, for example SO-10023. Take it from the customer or from find_orders.

tools.name: create_return
tools.title: Start a return
tools.description: Starts a return for one line of a delivered AIDevMe order and returns the return number (RMA). Confirm the item, quantity and reason with the customer before calling it.

orderId.description: Order number in the format SO-<digits>, for example SO-10023.

lineNumber.description: Line number of the item, taken from get_order_status (1, 2, 3 ...). Never guess it from how the customer counts items.

quantity.description: How many units to return: at least 1 and at most the quantity on that order line.

reason.description: Return reason: Damaged, WrongItem, NotAsDescribed or NoLongerNeeded.

comment.description: Optional note in the customer's words, for example 'Lid cracked on arrival'. Max 500 characters.
